name: Apeirophobia
desc:
Centered around the exploration and documentation. Stuck inside endless rooms, being watched from every corner. Brace yourself for puzzles to solve, and entities to hide from. escape from reality...

Credits:
The game was inspired by K. Pixels, some content is from The Backrooms Wiki.

For the best experience.
📈 Turn on max graphics.
🎧 Use Headphones.

WARNING!
This experience contains Sudden jumpscares, Flashing lights, and Loud noises.

Includes PC & Mobile & XBOX support.

Join our group to receive in-game perks!
https://www.roblox.com/groups/15422038
Also, join our community server for updates & sneak peeks!
